description: Step-by-step formalization and compliance workflow for the Business Companion module

steps.title: Business plan
steps.aiAssistance: Explains what a business plan is and helps draft one so the user adjusts numbers instead of starting blank.

steps.title: Choose a structure (Sole proprietor, (Pty) Ltd or co-operative)
steps.aiAssistance: Explains options in plain words regarding liability, tax, and funding eligibility.

steps.title: Apply for / reserve the name
steps.aiAssistance: Explains step-by-step how to reserve a name with CIPC.

steps.title: Register the business
steps.aiAssistance: Answers questions the user does not understand during registration.

steps.title: Register for tax
steps.aiAssistance: Explains income tax and VAT basics, prompts checking the current VAT threshold, and suggests an accountant.

steps.title: Occupational and health certificates / permits
steps.whereToDoIt: Local municipality, Dept. of Water and Sanitation, GLOBALG.A.P.
steps.aiAssistance: Explains what permits are required and where to obtain them.

steps.title: Business bank account
steps.aiAssistance: Explains what documents to bring and points to physical bank locations.

steps.title: Employee registrations (only if the business has employees)
steps.whereToDoIt: Dept. of Employment and Labour / uFiling

steps.title: Keep records
steps.aiAssistance: Explains what records to keep (invoices, statements, payroll) and retention periods (SARS generally requires 5 years).

steps.title: Apply for funding
steps.aiAssistance: Points to potential funders and explains what documents they ask for.
